descriptionNullable:
The Thai Call Center Call Log Dataset is a simulated collection of Thai-language phone conversations, created for use in NLP, voice assistant training, scam detection, and conversational AI. Each row represents a phone call with a labeled intent type. The dialogues mimic real-life interactions in Thailand, covering casual chats, scams, verification calls, and official messages.

Each conversation is formatted using [Call](...) and [User](...) tags to separate speaker roles for better parsing and modeling. This dataset is especially useful for fine-tuning Thai language models, creating AI phone agents, or training spam filters.
